description: Option snapshots. Get option snapshots from the SIP data feed for US equities (stocks and ETFs) and supported indices only. Rows may include previous and current daily bars, latest quote and trade, Greeks, and implied volatility. Filter by strike, range, expiration, or type, and use next_token for further pages. Timestamps are Unix milliseconds. → Returns {underlying_code: string, last_price?: number, next_token?: string, data: [{code: string, prev?: object, daily?: object, latest_quote?: object, latest_trade?: object, greeks?: {delta?: number, gamma?: number, rho?: number, theta?: number, vega?: number}, implied_volatility?: number}]}. prev/daily contain OHLCV, trade_count, and vwap; latest_quote contains bid/ask and sizes; latest_trade contains last_price and size. Sections and fields may be omitted when unavailable. Search for the underlying with search_symbols; use CBOE:VIX_W for VIX weekly options. Strike overrides range; from/to override expiration. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000. Follow next_token with the same filters. Use get_options_contracts for metadata or get_symbol_series with a returned code for historical bars. Guide: https://insightsentry.com/docs/options.

code.description: (Required) Symbol code in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL). Use search_symbols to find the correct code.

expiration.description: (Optional) Exact expiration date. Validated but not used when from or to is provided. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

from.description: (Optional) Minimum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

next_token.description: (Optional) Pagination token from a previous /v3/options/snapshot response. Send the same filters plus next_token to request the next page.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

range.description: (Optional) Strike price range as a percentage of the current underlying price. For example, range=10 returns only options with strikes within ±10% of the current price. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000. Ignored when strike is provided. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

strike.description: (Optional) Exact strike price. Takes precedence over range when both are provided.

to.description: (Optional) Maximum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

name: get_options_snapshot
